summary: @jaffathecake Any time I teach a reading skill I hope everyone applies it correctly knowing full well they won't. Doesn't mean books should hide all the big words and complicated concepts. Reading the web should be no different. Been a tension since beginning.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @jaffathecake Any time I teach a reading skill I hope everyone applies it correctly knowing full well they won't. Doesn't mean books should hide all the big words and complicated concepts. Reading the web should be no different. Been a tension since beginning.
